title: Codex 小队 · 耗时徽标组件规范标本 (Time Chip Specimen)
transplant: Original .time-chip DOM, 10px clock SVG, 2px 5px padding, 4px gap and radius, 10px/14px mono type, five tier colours and the 240px footer row are transplanted; runtime replaces the specimen text with observed durations.
overrides: Tier colour is a display-only duration band; it never replaces or annotates the task status badge.
Chip text carries only the complete duration; running, accumulated and last-confirmed context lives in title and aria-label so long prefixes cannot push the token value.
